column2: [intro]
When I’m on stage, I’m full of energy,
I’m the king of the party, the king of the spree.
My dance moves are legendary, I light up the floor,
I’m the pop maestro, the artistic encore.
I want to do pop, pop everywhere I go,
Sing, dance, make the world glow.
I want success, glory, and fans who cheer,
I want to make a splash, I want a career.
On social media, I’m number one,
My selfies make the buzz, my life’s a marathon run.
I’m the champion of hashtags, the king of the like,
I’m the dream maker, the critics’ delight.
I want to do pop, pop everywhere I go,
Sing, dance, make the world glow.
I want success, glory, and fans who cheer,
I want to make a splash, I want a career.
